description: Atlyn Resource Capacity compares allocated amounts with available capacity across resources and ordered periods. See overloads, zero capacity, missing data, and model-supplied nonworking states without confusing them. Review formatted allocation and capacity values, utilization, and full cell details; move directly between overloaded intersections and use native Power BI selection to explore related report visuals. Use people-hours by week, machine-hours by day, or another explicitly compatible unit. The semantic model controls granularity and availability. Duplicate delivered intersections are rejected, partial data is disclosed, and row totals require an explicit additive-measure assertion. The visual is read-only. It does not schedule tasks, infer holidays, spread daily workloads, level resources, calculate critical paths, change assignments, or write data back. FTE, rates, and snapshots usually require totals to remain off. Large analyses are bounded to 200 resources, 104 periods, and 10,000 cells or records; exports may reflect only the visible tile. Runtime rendering is local without external requests, telemetry, activation, feature gates, or licensing services. Author use requires an active paid or trial Atlyn all-access subscription under the Atlyn customer terms.
